parameters.content:
# 🐰 Cartoon Studio — Season Producer (n8n)

Automates Doraemon-style cartoon episodes & seasons with consistent characters, voices and voiceovers.

**Data lives in one Google Sheet** (3 tabs):
- `Episodes`: Season, Episode, Title, Logline, MusicUrl, TargetDuration, Status, Approval, EpisodeUrl
- `Scenes`: RowId, Season, Episode, SceneNo, Character, DialogueLine, Action, ImagePrompt, DurationSeconds, Status, AudioUrl, ImageUrl, VideoUrl, SyncedUrl
- Config (Set node `Config`): Character Bible JSON, API keys, style prompt.

**Per scene:** TTS (ElevenLabs, locked character voice) → Image (NanoBanana, character ref + style lock) → Video (VEO3 image-to-video) → Lipsync (Sync Labs) → row updated in sheet.
**Per episode:** scenes stitched + music + subtitles (episode assembler service) → approval gate (Telegram) → publish (Blotato → YouTube/TikTok/IG/FB) → sheet marked PUBLISHED.

Consistency rules: same Character Bible voice_id + reference image for every scene; same style prompt + style reference image; same season music track.

assignments.name: STYLE_PROMPT
assignments.value: Doraemon-style 2D anime, bright flat colors, thick clean black outlines, simple geometric shapes, kawaii, sunny suburban Japan, 16:9

assignments.name: DEFAULT_CAPTION
assignments.value: New episode of the series is out! #cartoon #animation #kids

assignments.name: CHARACTER_BIBLE

parameters.jsCode:
const prompt = 'Scene ' + $json.SceneNo + ': ' + ($json.Action || '') + ' ' + $json.DialogueLine + ' — ' + $json.Character + ', ' + $json.STYLE_PROMPT + ', consistent character, same outfit as reference image, 16:9.';
return { json: { videoPrompt: prompt } };

const payload = { videoUrl: $json.videoUrl, audioUrl: $json.audioUrl };
return { json: { synclabsBody: JSON.stringify(payload) } };

const synced = $json.outputUrl || $json.videoUrl || '';
return { json: { ...$json, syncedUrl: synced, note: $json.outputUrl ? 'lipsync OK' : 'lipsync unavailable, using raw video' } };
return { json: { Status: 'FAILED', Error: 'VEO3 render did not complete', AudioUrl: $json.audio_url || '', ImageUrl: $json.image_url || '', VideoUrl: $json.videoUrl || '', SyncedUrl: '' } };
